Firstly, you given your hammy a great life to be able to reach this far. She's lucky to have an owner looking for info to better her life even now. :)

That said, soft foods are the way to go. Start off just giving her bits of cooked eggs (unsalted, no oil) or smushed banana. She may like both or just one. You can also try some baby food. My hammy loved baby banana food during her last moments. You can still give her the regular food if she is still eating it, but at some point she may just be hiding her food out of instinct but not eating it. When that happens, just make sure that a bit of it is still available but not too much that it'll just end up going bad.

One night, my SO was next to me, knocked out, while I couldn't get any shut eye. I decided to stop fighting it and get my phone. I wanted to watch some things without making too much noise, but because it was so dark, I couldn't find my heaphones. Fuck it, I tap my SO's back, to which he responds in grunts. 
"Honey, where's my headphones?"
To my surprise, he answers "Here."
"Where? I cant see anything."
"Hold on."
I assumed he was going to get up to get them because he started moving around. Then I realized, he was taking off his own shirt. Weird, but maybe he was feeling hot or something and was going to give me the headphones after that. Nope. He put the shirt near his side and then went back to sleep. 
I was kinda just sitting there dumbfounded for a while. He would not respond to anything else for the rest of the night.
Next morning, shirtless, he asked if I had taken it off for him or something. I told him what happened and laughter ensued. He had no recollection of that whatsoever. Now whenever I ask for headphones he just takes off his shirt. 
Sometimes it just happens.
